prompts.head:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one production sprite atlas for a customizable basketball portrait system. The attached image is the STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its attractive, warm inked sports-illustration quality, natural rounded anatomy, tasteful cel shading, clear contour ink, and healthy cheek volume. This is artwork to be layered beneath separate eyes, noses, mouths, hair, and ears.
Create ONE transparent PNG atlas, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of 8 equally sized cells, no gutters. Every cell is a 256 by 320 logical canvas; atlas aspect ratio 1024:640. Each cell contains ONLY a front-facing BALD head silhouette, no ears, no neck, no clothing, NO eyes/eyebrows/nose/mouth/facial hair. The center of the face is smooth clean skin with gentle cheek and forehead shading, ready to receive feature overlays. Head top at local x128 y28, temples x48..208 at y135, chin centered y282. No object may leave its cell. Use NEUTRAL GRAYSCALE cel-painted skin: mid-gray 165/165/165, restrained gray shadows and highlights, dark-gray outline; this permits later skin-tone coloring in-game. Alpha background truly transparent.
Exact order: top row masculine oval head; masculine broad round head; masculine longer narrow head; masculine soft square jaw. Bottom row feminine oval head; feminine round/full-cheek head; feminine long/slender head; feminine softly squared head. Make them clearly distinct in cheeks, jaw and chin; all are human, healthy, appealing, not skull-like or rigid. Keep the same skull top, eye-line (y143), nose-line (y199), mouth-line (y237) and chin level (y282) in all 8. NO text, labels, numbers, borders, checkerboard, ground plane, cast shadow or background. The grayscale is a technical asset requirement; the FINISHED ART STYLE is exactly the reference, not flat clip art.
